name: Rate of change 12 sign flip
description: TREND FOLLOWING (time-series momentum). The oldest rule in the family: buy when the 12-period rate of change turns positive, sell when it turns negative. Canonical parameters, declared and not searched: a 12-period lookback is the one academic time-series momentum uses (Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen 2012, twelve months), and the 12-month formation window of Jegadeesh and Titman 1993. BORN ON THE MONTHLY AND DAILY - it is the most brutally transplanted of the ten, since here twelve bars mean an hour on M5. Included precisely because it makes the transplant visible.
